name: Raised PO
query:
SELECT 
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    so.transaction_date AS "SO Date:Date",
    soi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    soi.item_name AS "Item Name::150",
    soi.qty AS "Required Qty:Float:100",
    bin.actual_qty AS "Available Qty:Float:100",
    (soi.qty - COALESCE(bin.actual_qty, 0)) AS "Shortfall Qty:Float:100",
    po.name AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    po.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:150",
    po.transaction_date AS "PO Date:Date"
FROM 
    `tabSales Order` so
JOIN 
    `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabBin` bin ON soi.item_code = bin.item_code AND bin.warehouse = so.set_warehouse
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order Item` poi ON soi.item_code = poi.item_code
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order` po ON poi.parent = po.name
WHERE 
    so.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
    AND (bin.actual_qty < soi.qty OR bin.actual_qty IS NULL)
    AND po.name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    so.transaction_date DESC;
